title: Unit Event — Cheer With My Heart! — Episode8 Inherited Heart

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! has received an invitation to the Lumina Grand Prix, an idol TV program organized by Ms. Arisawa. At the orientation, the legendary idol speaks of the idea of a "true idol", which resonates with Airi.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're starting to slow down, Minori!
Keep swinging your arms!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You need to relax your upper body more, Shizuku! Try to stay loose!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nice work! Three more laps to go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. MEIKO makes for a tough drill sergeant...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You can do it, girls!
Go, go, MORE MORE JUMP♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For today's talk-show lesson, I'm going to have you come up with funny one-liners on the spot to improve your thinking speed and cleverness.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, here's your first question!
“In a previous life, this cat was an idol! How could you tell?”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! Because it's really cute!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Speed and confidence are important, but that's a bit of a weak response since cats are cute to begin with.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Umm... What if it's because it kneads in a rhythmical manner?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: O-Oh no... My heart's melting just imagining that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Leave it to Haruka to come up with a tough workout. Having planks at the end really embodies her work ethic.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(She has her right arm and left leg raised...?
And she's not even out of breath.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Alright, I'm also gonna raise the bar and give it another go...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But it definitely feels like I've come a long way.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I've gotta maintain this momentum and keep doing everything I can.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Before I go to bed, I'll stretch, put together another talk-show lesson plan and... Oh, I should take a look at that idol program I recorded.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This episode was supposed to involve following a popular idol around...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, do I still have the recording of that episode of Close-up Professional...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see... I wanna say the DVD Mom burned for me was... Oh, here it is!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's pretty old... I hope it still plays.

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line:
<Okay, that felt pretty good!
I should do another run while it's still fresh in my head...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Hiyori really is an amazing person...
She's always shining so bright.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Just watching her fills me with encouragement!)

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <My goal is to put smiles on the faces of those who are watching me.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I want them to look forward to giving the next day their very best.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <I think that's why I'm able to maintain my optimism like this.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That's right. Those were the words that made me...)

rows.Speaker: Camera Operator
rows.Line: <That motto suits you very well, Hiyori.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line:
<Thank you!
But it's actually another person's words.>

rows.Speaker: Hiyori
rows.Line: <A legendary idol whom I admire very much...>

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: That is why I think true idols are those who can spread hope simply by being who they are.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: And most importantly, they must have hearts full of persistent optimism. That is my solemn belief.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I have to do my absolute best...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I need to put all my heart into creating an unwavering beacon.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (To spread hope to as many people as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I'll give the Lumina Grand Prix everything I've got!
